title: Engine Backup Speed Sensor Error
detail_of_failure: Error is sensed in the signal from engine Bkup speed sensor (CAM).
controller_action: Continues control with signals of the engine Ne speed sensor.
machine_effect: • Engine startability is deteriorated (when Ne speed sensor is normal). • Running engine stops (when Ne speed sensor is also defective). • Stopped engine cannot be started (when Ne speed sensor is also defective).
related_information: • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Start the engine. • The inside of the speed sensor consists of a hall sensor and electronic circuit instead of a coil. So you cannot judge whether the sensor is correct or not by measurement of the resistance of the speed sensor with a multimeter. • Because the speed sensor output is a 5V pulse voltage, it cannot be measured with a multimeter. • The speed sensor senses the speed by the groove in the speed sensing ring installed to the camshaft.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.
If failure code [CA187] or [CA227] is also shown at the same time, do the troubleshooting for that code first.

steps.cause: Breakage or defective installation (looseness) of engine Bkup speed (CAM) sensor
steps.procedure: There can be breakage or defective installation (looseness) of the engine Bkup speed (CAM) sensor. Check it.

steps.cause: Defective engine Bkup speed sensor power supply input
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector CAM SENSOR, and connect a T-adapter to the female side. 3. Starting switch: ON

measurements.point: Between CAM SENSOR (female) (1) and (2) / Power supply

steps.cause: Open circuit in wiring harness (wire breakage or defective contact of connector)
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect ECM and CAM SENSOR. Connect a T-adapter to each female side.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and CAM SENSOR, and connect a T- adapter to one of them on the female side.

measurements.point: Between ECM (female) (26) and (37), or between CAM SENSOR (female) (1) and (3)
Between ECM (female) (26) and (47), or between CAM SENSOR (female) (2) and (3)

steps.cause: Ground fault in wiring harness (contact with ground circuit)
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and CAM SENSOR, and connect a T- adapter to one of them on the female side.

measurements.point: Between ground and ECM (female) (26) or CAM SEN- SOR (female) (3)

steps.cause: Hot short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect CAM SENSOR, and connect a T-adapter to the female side. 3. Starting switch: ON
Remove the engine Bkup speed (CAM) sensor. Check directly through hole (H). REMARK If the speed detection ring (B) is loose, see “REFERENCE”.
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine Bkup speed (CAM) sensor is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
